data.name: Bertolde
data.long_meaning: The name Bertolde is derived from the Old Germanic word 'berht' meaning bright or famous, and 'hild' meaning battle or strife. This name was popular during the Middle Ages and is often associated with strength and courage in battle. In the Christian context, it can be seen as a symbol of faith and bravery in the face of adversity.
